title: An integer multiplicity representation carries no H^n-mass off the support of the current
statement: Let P, n be natural numbers, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (a GeometricCurrentOn U n) and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) representing T, i.e. T(ω) = ∫_M θ ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dH^n for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U). Then H^n(M ∖ spt T) = 0, where spt T = U ∖ ⋃{W : W open, closure W compact, closure W ⊆ U, T vanishes on W} (Simon 6.2.11).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ T.support) = 0
